title: fix(components)!: the filter builder's list value holds the spec list's entries, so a boolean switched to In is a rule the spec accepts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Bvvb9XG5ZxhuycX3NS7AUQ)_

Fixes #26348

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:筛选构建器里「等于 true」的行切到「属于」时，不再产出 spec 拒收的 `[true]`,而是 `["true"]`;构建器行值的列表成员收窄为 spec 的字符串/数字列表。
- 为什么改:构建器自己产出的筛选规则被 `ViewFilterRuleSchema` 拒收，保存视图时才报错;这是 #26306 留下的半截。
- 风险与回滚:仅编译期收窄，运行时只改布尔值进列表时的拼写;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`filter-builder.tsx` 的 `toFilterListEntry` / `normalizeToArray`;`UserFilters.tsx` 的 `lookupPickerValue`;changeset。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-boolean-list-26348.test.tsx`,应 4 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`FilterBuilderRow.value`** (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`) is now exactly `ViewFilterRule['value']`. The builder's own wider list member `(string | number | boolean)[]` is gone. A module-private `FilterListEntry` reads the list element from the spec's value type instead of restating it.
- **The source writer.** Every list or range the builder builds from a scalar goes through one conversion, `toFilterListEntry`: a boolean becomes its string spelling (`true` becomes `"true"`). It is called by `normalizeToArray` (so `reshapeFilterValue`'s list and pair arms), by `retypeFilterValue`'s list and pair arms, by `MultiValueInput`'s commit and by the range input's `setBound`. That is the conversion the builder already made for a boolean that reaches a text column, and every bucket offering a list operator is a text-family column (`select` / `lookup`). The list controls compare entries with `String()`, so the option whose value is `"true"` stays ticked.
- **`UserFilters`** (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`) hands a lookup chip's selection to `LookupValuePicker` through `lookupPickerValue`, the same conversion. The selection map stays typed for every control kind, because a boolean chip's selection really is `[true]`. The two casts in the picker's `onChange` are gone, since the narrowed value no longer needs them.
- `docs/FilterBuilder.md` shows the new member. No sdui record. The per-package records were retired by #26367 while this PR was open. The main merge took the modify/delete with `git rm`, and CI's Build & E2E UI regenerates the manifest. Changeset: `.changeset/26348-filter-builder-boolean-list-entry.md` (`patch` for both packages, BREAKING banner, prose migration for writers).

### Writers measured (the card's step 1)

| writer | produced a boolean list entry? | now |
|---|---|---|
| operator switch, `changeOperator` → `reshapeFilterValue` → `normalizeToArray` | yes: `equals true` → `in` gave `[true]`; → `between` gave `[true, ""]` | `["true"]`, `["true", ""]` |
| field switch, `retypeFilterValue` list / pair arms | type-level only: a text target already stringified, the boolean family has no list operator | typed through `toFilterListEntry` |
| `MultiValueInput` commit, range `setBound` | type-level only: their inputs hand back strings and numbers | typed through `toFilterListEntry` |
| checkbox list, `LookupValuePicker.toggleId` | no: option values and ids are strings and numbers | unchanged |
| `UserFilters` lookup chip → `LookupValuePicker` | yes: an authored `defaultValues: [true]` on a lookup filter field reached the query as `[true, id]` | `["true", id]` |

The compiler confirmed the list: narrowing the member first left exactly one more site red (the range writer, TS2322), fixed here.

### ADR-0087 stop-check (the card's step 3)

Run before the narrowing edit, against a throwaway probe commit (the narrowing line plus a probe changeset with a prose migration), with `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main --head PROBE_SHA`: exit 0, `not-required (runtime-interface-only) -- verified: ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx#FilterBuilderRow (interface)`. No literal FROM → TO is needed for writers, so no ADR wording and no decision were needed. The real changeset carries the same disposition and passes the gate on this head.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-boolean-list-26348.test.tsx`: type pins (`FilterBuilderRow['value']` equals the spec value; a boolean list is a `@ts-expect-error`; a boolean scalar stays admitted), the schema refusing `[true]` and accepting `["true"]` (non-vacuity), the real operator dropdown driving `equals true` → In and `equals false` → Not in with the emitted rule parsed by `ViewFilterRuleSchema`, and the helpers.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.lookupBooleanEntry-26348.test.tsx`: a lookup chip with an authored `true` default; a picked id joins it as `["true", "acc_1"]`; string and number ids pass through untouched.
- **Forced test edits**, both type pins that stated the old width on purpose so a narrowing would have to change them: `filter-builder-spec-row-26306.test.tsx` (the `Equal` pin and its docblock row) and `filter-builder-name-authority-9306.test.tsx` (the `Equal` pin and its comment).

## Acceptance notes

- A boolean on a date column switched to Between now carries `["true", ""]`: a spec-valid shape, but not a date the range input can show. Reaching it needs a host to hand a date column a boolean in the first place, and a field switch to a date column already clears it. Noted, not filed (no defect class: the builder never authors that row).
- `FilterBuilderSchema.onChange` signature mismatch (out of scope by the card). Measured on this head: `FilterBuilderSchema` in `ui/packages/types/src/complex.ts` declares `onChange?: (filter: FilterGroup) => void`, while the `filter-builder` renderer calls `onChange` with a `{ target: { name, value } }` event shape. Reported to the seat in the report's `out_of_scope_findings`; not touched here.

## Verification

All readings on head `80dc2dca` (after merging `origin/main` at `6390fe52`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>Type-check and tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): green before and after the merge. The new `@ts-expect-error` pin compiles only because the boolean list is refused.
- Before the merge, both whole packages: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/ packages/plugin-list/`: Test Files 600 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 5913 passed, 24 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- After the merge, scoped (main moved `components` renderers): `packages/components/src/__tests__/` plus `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters*`: Test Files 259 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 2528 passed; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Console: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2`: 71 of 71 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

Through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
- `normalizeToArray` back to keeping the boolean: `filter-builder-boolean-list-26348.test.tsx` goes 3 failed, 1 passed (the schema non-vacuity case stays green).
- `lookupPickerValue` back to the identity: `UserFilters.lookupBooleanEntry-26348.test.tsx` goes 1 failed, 1 passed (the pass-through case stays green).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 45 families on this head; all 45 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Among them `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` verifies the `runtime-interface-only` disposition, and `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is green on the re-recorded sources.
- Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery (owed by the narrowing arm)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` after building its closure: Test Files 2 failed, 297 passed, 3 skipped; Tests 10 failed, 2521 passed, 18 skipped. Every failure is in `test/authz-conformance.test.ts` (the #17111 ledger-figure pins: "packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts: docblock says 80 rows, the table holds 81") and `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (the #13260 census over `rest-route-ledger.ts` and `rest-server.ts`). This diff touches no file under `packages/rest`; both files last changed on `main` in #26361 (the record-anchored approval lock read), so this is a main-side red, reported to the seat, not fixed here.

</details>
